table account
  col accessToken                    text
  col accessTokenExpiresAt           timestamp with time zone
  col accountId                      text NOT NULL
  col createdAt                      timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col id                             text NOT NULL
  col idToken                        text
  col issuer                         text
  col password                       text
  col providerId                     text NOT NULL
  col refreshToken                   text
  col refreshTokenExpiresAt          timestamp with time zone
  col scope                          text
  col updatedAt                      timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col userId                         text NOT NULL
  pk  account_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  account_userId_fkey FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  rls enabled

  col user_id                        text
  ck  zv_ai_usage_operation_check CHECK ((operation = ANY (ARRAY['chat'::text, 'embed'::text, 'query'::text, 'generate'::text, 'decide'::text])))
  pk  zv_ai_usage_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zv_ai_usage_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zv_ai_usage FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zv_checklist_scheme_weights
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col scheme_id                      uuid NOT NULL
  col template_item_id               uuid NOT NULL
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col weight                         numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  pk  zv_checklist_scheme_weights_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zv_checklist_scheme_weights_scheme_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (scheme_id) REFERENCES zv_checklist_scoring_schemes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  uq  zv_checklist_scheme_weights_scheme_id_template_item_id_key UNIQUE (scheme_id, template_item_id)
  fk  zv_checklist_scheme_weights_template_item_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (template_item_id) REFERENCES zv_checklist_template_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  ck  zv_checklist_scheme_weights_weight_check CHECK ((weight >= (0)::numeric))

  pk  zv_checklist_scores_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

table zv_checklist_scoring_schemes
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text
  col description                    text
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col is_active                      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  col method                         text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'weighted_completion'::text
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col pass_threshold                 numeric
  col template_id                    uuid NOT NULL
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  ck  zv_checklist_scoring_schemes_method_check CHECK ((method = 'weighted_completion'::text))
  ck  zv_checklist_scoring_schemes_pass_threshold_check CHECK (((pass_threshold IS NULL) OR ((pass_threshold >= (0)::numeric) AND (pass_threshold <= (100)::numeric))))
  pk  zv_checklist_scoring_schemes_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zv_checklist_scoring_schemes_template_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (template_id) REFERENCES zv_checklist_templates(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  idx uq_checklist_scheme_name UNIQUE (tenant_id, template_id, name)

table zv_cloud_access_logs
  col action                         text NOT NULL
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col file_id                        text NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col ip                             text
  col share_token                    text
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col user_agent                     text
  col user_id                        text
  ck  zv_cloud_access_logs_action_check CHECK ((action = ANY (ARRAY['view'::text, 'download'::text, 'upload'::text, 'delete'::text, 'share'::text, 'version'::text])))
  pk  zv_cloud_access_logs_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zv_cloud_access_logs FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zv_edge_functions
  col code                           text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text
  col description                    text
  col display_name                   text NOT NULL
  col env_vars                       jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col http_method                    text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'POST'::text
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col is_active                      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col path                           text NOT NULL
  col runtime                        text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bun'::text
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col timeout_ms                     integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 30000
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  pk  zv_edge_functions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  uq  zv_edge_functions_tenant_name_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, name)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zv_edge_functions FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)

  col user_agent                     text
  pk  zv_license_audit_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)

table zv_mail_accounts
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col display_name                   text
  col email_address                  text NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col imap_host                      text NOT NULL
  col imap_idle_supported            boolean
  col imap_password                  text NOT NULL
  col imap_port                      integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 993
  col imap_secure                    boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  col imap_user                      text NOT NULL
  col is_active                      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  col is_default                     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  col last_sync_at                   timestamp with time zone
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col oauth2_access_token            text
  col oauth2_expires_at              timestamp with time zone
  col oauth2_provider                text
  col oauth2_refresh_token           text
  col sieve_host                     text
  col sieve_port                     integer DEFAULT 4190
  col smtp_host                      text NOT NULL
  col smtp_password                  text
  col smtp_port                      integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 587
  col smtp_secure                    boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  col smtp_user                      text
  col sync_error                     text
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col user_id                        text NOT NULL
  ck  zv_mail_accounts_oauth2_provider_check CHECK ((oauth2_provider = ANY (ARRAY['gmail'::text, 'outlook'::text, NULL::text])))
  pk  zv_mail_accounts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zv_mail_accounts_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  idx idx_mail_accounts_default UNIQUE (user_id) WHERE (is_default = true)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zv_mail_accounts FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zv_mail_drafts
  col account_id                     uuid NOT NULL
  col attachments                    jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  col auto_saved_at                  timestamp with time zone
  col bcc_addresses                  jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  col body_html                      text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  col body_text                      text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  col cc_addresses                   jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col identity_id                    uuid
  col imap_uid                       integer
  col in_reply_to                    text
  col original_msg_id                uuid
  col priority                       text DEFAULT 'normal'::text
  col references_hdr                 text
  col reply_type                     text
  col request_read_receipt           boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  col subject                        text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''::text
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col to_addresses                   jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  fk  zv_mail_drafts_account_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (account_id) REFERENCES zv_mail_accounts(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  fk  zv_mail_drafts_identity_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (identity_id) REFERENCES zv_mail_identities(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  fk  zv_mail_drafts_original_msg_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (original_msg_id) REFERENCES zv_mail_messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  pk  zv_mail_drafts_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zv_mail_drafts_priority_check CHECK ((priority = ANY (ARRAY['high'::text, 'normal'::text, 'low'::text])))
  ck  zv_mail_drafts_reply_type_check CHECK ((reply_type = ANY (ARRAY['reply'::text, 'reply_all'::text, 'forward'::text, NULL::text])))
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zv_mail_drafts FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

  col account_id                     uuid NOT NULL

  col is_read                        boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  col is_signed                      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  col is_starred                     boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  col message_id                     text
  col priority                       text DEFAULT 'normal'::text
  col raw_headers                    jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col read_receipt_requested         boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  col read_receipt_sent              boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  col received_at                    timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col references_header              text
  col reply_to                       text
  col sent_at                        timestamp with time zone
  col snippet                        text
  col subject                        text

  col thread_id                      text
  col to_addresses                   jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  col uid                            integer

  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

  col parent_id                      uuid
  col record_id                      text NOT NULL
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col user_id                        text
  fk  zv_record_comments_parent_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES zv_record_comments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  pk  zv_record_comments_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zv_record_comments_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zv_record_comments FOR * USING (tenant_id = ANY (( SELECT zveltio_visible_tenants() AS zveltio_visible_tenants)::uuid[])) CHECK zveltio_tenant_write_ok(tenant_id)

  ck  zv_revisions_action_check CHECK ((action = ANY (ARRAY['create'::text, 'update'::text, 'delete'::text])))
  pk  zv_revisions_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zv_revisions_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

  col period                         text NOT NULL
  col price_score                    integer NOT NULL
  col quality_score                  integer NOT NULL

  ck  zv_ro_supplier_evaluations_price_score_check CHECK (((price_score >= 1) AND (price_score <= 5)))

  fk  zv_ro_supplier_evaluations_supplier_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES zv_ro_suppliers(id)
  uq  zv_ro_supplier_evaluations_supplier_id_period_key UNIQUE (supplier_id, period)

  pk  zv_sms_templates_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zv_sms_templates FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zv_tenant_users
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col invited_by                     text
  col joined_at                      timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col read_scope                     text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'self'::text
  col role                           text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member'::text
  col scope_list                     ARRAY
  col tenant_id                      uuid NOT NULL
  col user_id                        text NOT NULL
  col valid_from                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col valid_to                       timestamp with time zone
  fk  zv_tenant_users_invited_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (invited_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  pk  zv_tenant_users_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zv_tenant_users_read_scope_check CHECK ((read_scope = ANY (ARRAY['self'::text, 'subtree'::text, 'list'::text, 'org'::text])))
  ck  zv_tenant_users_role_check CHECK ((role = ANY (ARRAY['owner'::text, 'admin'::text, 'member'::text, 'viewer'::text])))
  ck  zv_tenant_users_scope_list_check CHECK ((((read_scope = 'list'::text) AND (scope_list IS NOT NULL) AND (cardinality(scope_list) > 0)) OR ((read_scope <> 'list'::text) AND (scope_list IS NULL))))
  fk  zv_tenant_users_tenant_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES zv_tenants(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  uq  zv_tenant_users_tenant_id_user_id_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, user_id)
  fk  zv_tenant_users_user_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

  col trial_ends_at                  timestamp with time zone

  fk  zv_tenants_merged_into_fkey FOREIGN KEY (merged_into) REFERENCES zv_tenants(id)
  fk  zv_tenants_parent_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES zv_tenants(id)
  pk  zv_tenants_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zv_tenants_plan_check CHECK ((plan = ANY (ARRAY['free'::text, 'pro'::text, 'enterprise'::text, 'custom'::text])))
  uq  zv_tenants_slug_key UNIQUE (slug)
  ck  zv_tenants_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'suspended'::text, 'deleted'::text])))

table zvd_assets
  col accumulated_dep_account_id     uuid
  col accumulated_depreciation       numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col category                       text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'equipment'::text
  col code                           text NOT NULL
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text NOT NULL
  col current_value                  numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col depreciation_account_id        uuid
  col depreciation_method            text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'straight_line'::text
  col description                    text
  col disposal_reason                text
  col disposal_value                 numeric
  col disposed_at                    date
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col image_url                      text
  col location                       text
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col next_maintenance_date          date
  col purchase_cost                  numeric NOT NULL
  col purchase_date                  date NOT NULL
  col residual_value                 numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col serial_number                  text
  col status                         text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'::text
  col supplier                       text
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col useful_life_years              integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 5
  col warranty_expiry                date
  ck  zvd_assets_category_check CHECK ((category = ANY (ARRAY['building'::text, 'equipment'::text, 'vehicle'::text, 'furniture'::text, 'software'::text, 'land'::text, 'other'::text])))
  uq  zvd_assets_code_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, code)
  ck  zvd_assets_depreciation_method_check CHECK ((depreciation_method = ANY (ARRAY['straight_line'::text, 'declining_balance'::text, 'none'::text])))
  pk  zvd_assets_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zvd_assets_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'disposed'::text, 'in_maintenance'::text])))
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_assets FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_ec_orders
  col billing_address                jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col canonical_contact_id           uuid
  col coupon_code                    text
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text NOT NULL
  col currency                       text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'RON'::text
  col customer_email                 text NOT NULL
  col customer_id                    uuid
  col customer_name                  text NOT NULL
  col discount                       numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col metadata                       jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col notes                          text
  col order_number                   text NOT NULL
  col payment_method                 text
  col payment_status                 text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unpaid'::text
  col shipping_address               jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col shipping_cost                  numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col shipping_tracking              text
  col shipping_zone_id               uuid
  col status                         text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::text
  col subtotal                       numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col tax_amount                     numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col total                          numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col tracking_number                text
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  fk  ec_orders_canonical_fk FOREIGN KEY (canonical_contact_id) REFERENCES zvd_contacts(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  fk  zvd_ec_orders_customer_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES zvd_ec_customers(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  uq  zvd_ec_orders_order_number_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, order_number)
  ck  zvd_ec_orders_payment_status_check CHECK ((payment_status = ANY (ARRAY['unpaid'::text, 'paid'::text, 'refunded'::text, 'partial'::text])))
  pk  zvd_ec_orders_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zvd_ec_orders_shipping_zone_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (shipping_zone_id) REFERENCES zvd_ec_shipping_zones(id)
  ck  zvd_ec_orders_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'processing'::text, 'shipped'::text, 'delivered'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'refunded'::text])))
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_ec_orders FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)

  pk  zvd_gdpr_access_requests_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zvd_gdpr_access_requests_request_type_check CHECK ((request_type = ANY (ARRAY['access'::text, 'erasure'::text, 'portability'::text, 'rectification'::text, 'restriction'::text, 'objection'::text])))
  ck  zvd_gdpr_access_requests_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'in_progress'::text, 'completed'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'withdrawn'::text])))
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_gdpr_access_requests FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

  col delegate_vehicle               text

  col discount_percent               numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0

  col exchange_rate                  numeric
  col footer_notes                   text
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()

  col next_issue_date                date

  col paid_at                        timestamp with time zone
  col po_number                      text
  col recurring_interval             text

  col seller_bank                    text
  col seller_city                    text
  col seller_country                 text
  col seller_county                  text

  col seller_name                    text

  col seller_tax_id                  text

table zvd_leave_balances
  col allocated_days                 numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col carried_over_days              numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col carryover_expires_at           date
  col employee_id                    uuid NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col leave_type_id                  uuid NOT NULL
  col pending_days                   numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col used_days                      numeric NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col year                           integer NOT NULL
  ck  zvd_leave_balances_days_are_numbers CHECK (((allocated_days <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND (carried_over_days <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND (used_days <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND (pending_days <> 'NaN'::numeric)))
  uq  zvd_leave_balances_employee_id_leave_type_id_year_key UNIQUE (employee_id, leave_type_id, year)
  fk  zvd_leave_balances_leave_type_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (leave_type_id) REFERENCES zvd_leave_types(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  pk  zvd_leave_balances_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_leave_balances FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_payroll_periods

  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col month                          integer NOT NULL
  col notes                          text
  col paid_at                        timestamp with time zone
  col status                         text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open'::text
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col year                           integer NOT NULL
  ck  zvd_payroll_periods_month_check CHECK (((month >= 1) AND (month <= 12)))
  pk  zvd_payroll_periods_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zvd_payroll_periods_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['open'::text, 'calculated'::text, 'approved'::text, 'closed'::text])))
  uq  zvd_payroll_periods_year_month_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, year, month)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_payroll_periods FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_performance_reviews
  col acknowledged_at                timestamp with time zone
  col comments                       text
  col competency_rating              numeric
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col cycle_id                       uuid NOT NULL
  col employee_id                    uuid NOT NULL
  col goals_rating                   numeric
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col improvements                   text
  col overall_rating                 numeric
  col reviewer_id                    text
  col status                         text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'::text
  col strengths                      text
  col submitted_at                   timestamp with time zone
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  ck  zvd_performance_reviews_competency_rating_check CHECK (((competency_rating >= (1)::numeric) AND (competency_rating <= (5)::numeric)))
  uq  zvd_performance_reviews_cycle_id_employee_id_key UNIQUE (cycle_id, employee_id)
  fk  zvd_performance_reviews_cycle_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES zvd_performance_cycles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  fk  zvd_performance_reviews_employee_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES zvd_employees(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  ck  zvd_performance_reviews_goals_rating_check CHECK (((goals_rating >= (1)::numeric) AND (goals_rating <= (5)::numeric)))
  ck  zvd_performance_reviews_overall_rating_check CHECK (((overall_rating >= (1)::numeric) AND (overall_rating <= (5)::numeric)))
  pk  zvd_performance_reviews_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zvd_performance_reviews_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'submitted'::text, 'acknowledged'::text])))
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_performance_reviews FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

  fk  zvd_quality_remediations_issue_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (issue_id) REFERENCES zv_quality_issues(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  pk  zvd_quality_remediations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_quality_remediations FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_task_dependencies
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()

  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col task_id                        uuid NOT NULL
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col type                           text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'finish_to_start'::text
  ck  zvd_task_dependencies_check CHECK ((task_id <> depends_on_id))
  fk  zvd_task_dependencies_depends_on_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (depends_on_id) REFERENCES zvd_tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  pk  zvd_task_dependencies_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  uq  zvd_task_dependencies_task_id_depends_on_id_key UNIQUE (task_id, depends_on_id)
  fk  zvd_task_dependencies_task_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES zvd_tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  ck  zvd_task_dependencies_type_check CHECK ((type = ANY (ARRAY['finish_to_start'::text, 'start_to_start'::text, 'finish_to_finish'::text])))
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_task_dependencies FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

  col tags                           ARRAY NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::text[]
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  uq  zvd_translation_keys_key_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, key)
  pk  zvd_translation_keys_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_translation_keys FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_translation_memory
  col context                        text
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col locale                         text NOT NULL
  col quality_score                  integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 100
  col source_text                    text NOT NULL
  col target_text                    text NOT NULL
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col usage_count                    integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  pk  zvd_translation_memory_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zvd_translation_memory_quality_score_check CHECK (((quality_score >= 0) AND (quality_score <= 100)))
  uq  zvd_translation_memory_source_text_locale_key UNIQUE (tenant_id, source_text, locale)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_translation_memory FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_translations
  col approved_at                    timestamp with time zone
  col approved_by                    text
  col char_count                     integer
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col is_machine_translated          boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  col key_id                         uuid NOT NULL
  col locale                         text NOT NULL
  col reviewed                       boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col updated_by                     text
  col value                          text NOT NULL
  fk  zvd_translations_key_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (key_id) REFERENCES zvd_translation_keys(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  uq  zvd_translations_key_id_locale_key UNIQUE (key_id, locale)
  fk  zvd_translations_locale_fkey FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, locale) REFERENCES zvd_locales(tenant_id, code) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT VALID
  pk  zvd_translations_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_translations FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_validation_import_log
  col collection                     text NOT NULL
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text NOT NULL
  col errors                         jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb
  col failed_count                   integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col imported_count                 integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  pk  zvd_validation_import_log_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_validation_import_log FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_validation_rule_groups
  col collection                     text NOT NULL
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text NOT NULL
  col description                    text
  col field_name                     text NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col is_active                      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  col logic                          text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AND'::text
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col rule_ids                       ARRAY NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::uuid[]
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  ck  zvd_validation_rule_groups_logic_check CHECK ((logic = ANY (ARRAY['AND'::text, 'OR'::text])))
  pk  zvd_validation_rule_groups_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_validation_rule_groups FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_validation_test_cases
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text NOT NULL
  col expected_result                boolean NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col input_value                    text NOT NULL
  col label                          text NOT NULL
  col last_run_at                    timestamp with time zone
  col last_run_result                boolean
  col rule_id                        uuid NOT NULL
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  pk  zvd_validation_test_cases_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_validation_test_cases FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_warehouses
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text NOT NULL
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col is_active                      boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
  col location                       text
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col notes                          text
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  pk  zvd_warehouses_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_warehouses FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_webhook_deliveries
  col attempt                        integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col delivered_at                   timestamp with time zone
  col error                          text
  col headers                        jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col max_attempts                   integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 3
  col method                         text NOT NULL
  col payload                        jsonb NOT NULL
  col response_body                  text
  col status                         integer
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col url                            text NOT NULL
  col webhook_id                     uuid NOT NULL
  pk  zvd_webhook_deliveries_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  fk  zvd_webhook_deliveries_webhook_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (webhook_id) REFERENCES zvd_webhooks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

table zvd_webhook_events
  col error                          text
  col headers                        jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col payload                        jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col received_at                    timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col source_ip                      text
  col status                         text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'received'::text
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col webhook_id                     uuid NOT NULL
  pk  zvd_webhook_events_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zvd_webhook_events_status_check CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['received'::text, 'processed'::text, 'failed'::text])))
  fk  zvd_webhook_events_webhook_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY (webhook_id) REFERENCES zvd_incoming_webhooks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
  rls enabled forced
  pol tenant_isolation_zvd_webhook_events FOR * USING zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id) CHECK zveltio_tenant_scope_ok(tenant_id)

table zvd_webhooks
  col active                         boolean DEFAULT true
  col collections                    ARRAY
  col created_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col created_by                     text
  col events                         ARRAY NOT NULL
  col headers                        jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
  col id                             uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid()
  col method                         text DEFAULT 'POST'::text
  col name                           text NOT NULL
  col retry_attempts                 integer DEFAULT 3
  col secret                         text
  col tenant_id                      uuid DEFAULT COALESCE((NULLIF(current_setting('zveltio.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid)
  col timeout                        integer DEFAULT 5000
  col updated_at                     timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
  col url                            text NOT NULL
  fk  zvd_webhooks_created_by_fkey FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
  ck  zvd_webhooks_method_check CHECK ((method = ANY (ARRAY['POST'::text, 'PUT'::text, 'PATCH'::text])))
  pk  zvd_webhooks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
  ck  zvd_webhooks_retry_attempts_check CHECK (((retry_attempts >= 0) AND (retry_attempts <= 10)))
  ck  zvd_webhooks_timeout_check CHECK (((timeout >= 1000) AND (timeout <= 30000)))
